meta._comment: 2D platformer metadata. Focus on movement and level design.
meta.title: My Platformer
meta.tagline: Jump, dash, and wall-jump through challenging levels
meta.description: Describe your platformer — theme, setting, main character, and what makes the platforming unique.
meta._comment_art_style: pixel_art_2d, retro_16bit, retro_8bit, minimalist, or hand_painted work well for platformers.

movement._comment: Movement is the heart of a platformer. Define all available moves.

combat._comment: Remove this section entirely if your platformer has no combat.

progression._comment_progression: Use 'metroidvania' if abilities unlock new areas, or 'level_based' for linear progression.

world._comment_structure: For platformers: 'level_based' for discrete stages, 'metroidvania' for interconnected world.

environments.name: Green Hills
environments.visual_description: Bright green rolling hills with blue sky. Simple, welcoming starting area. Pastel colors, cheerful atmosphere.
environments.audio_mood: Upbeat chiptune music, bird chirps, gentle wind.

sub_areas.name: Tutorial Zone
sub_areas.description: Teaches basic movement: run, jump, and land.

sub_areas.name: Hilltop Sprint
sub_areas.description: First real challenge with gaps and moving platforms.

environments.name: Crystal Caverns
environments.visual_description: Dark underground caves lit by glowing crystals. Blue and purple palette. Stalactites, underground lakes, crystal platforms.
environments.audio_mood: Echoing drips, deep ambient hum, crystalline chimes.

sub_areas.name: Crystal Maze
sub_areas.description: Platforms that shatter after stepping on them.

sub_areas.name: Dark Depths
sub_areas.description: Limited visibility. Light crystals guide the path.

environments.name: Lava Fortress
environments.visual_description: Volcanic area with rising lava, crumbling platforms, and fire traps. Red-orange palette with dark stone.
environments.audio_mood: Rumbling bass, crackling fire, industrial clanging.

sub_areas.name: The Gauntlet
sub_areas.description: Fast-paced section with rising lava chasing the player.

sub_areas.name: Boss Arena
sub_areas.description: Open arena for the final boss fight.

player.visual_description: Small character with expressive animations. Simple but iconic design.

abilities.name: Dash
abilities.description: Quick horizontal dash. Refreshes on landing.

abilities.name: Wall Jump
abilities.description: Jump off walls to reach higher places.

enemies.name: Slime
enemies.description: Bouncing blob that patrols back and forth.

enemies.name: Bat
enemies.description: Flying enemy that swoops at the player.

enemies.name: Fire Golem
enemies.description: Lava boss that throws fireballs and creates lava waves.

steps.description: Reach the Lava Fortress boss arena.
